# Decisions

Why we made non-obvious calls — the reasoning, the trade-offs, and what we ruled
out. Newest first. For what shipped and when, see
[`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md); for how things work, see
[`SYSTEM.md`](./SYSTEM.md).

### Monthly lease PDFs follow the official Burkina Faso lease template — 2026-10-21

**Decision:** The PDF generated by `POST /api/rental-agreements/[id]/generate-pdf` for a monthly agreement follows Salif's official lease template (`docs/contrat-de-bail-modele.pdf`) article by article: parties block (Bailleur, then Preneur), Articles 1 to 8, « Fait en quatre (4) exemplaires », Le Preneur and Le Bailleur signature blocks with « Lu et approuvé ». The legal wording is kept verbatim except obvious typos (listed in the PR). Every blank is atomic (Salif, 2026-10-22): one piece of information per labelled line, never two values on one label or one line (ID number, issue date and issue place are three lines; title deed number and date are two; Nom, Prénom, Lot, Parcelles, Section, Secteur, rue, porte, start and end dates, Fait à and le each have their own line). Every blank Roogo has data for is filled (names, city and quartier, usage, surface, equipment, dates, duration, rent and deposit in words and digits, phones, signature dates); every other blank prints as a dotted line to complete by hand, never « — » or « undefined ». Interdictions, owner rules, custom terms, the advance rent and the existing 7% rent-collection terms go into Article 4 III « Conditions particulières ». Daily (journalier) agreements keep the short-stay layout.

**Why:** A lease that looks like the form landlords, tenants and the tax office already know is easier to trust and to register than a Roogo-styled summary. The template is written for monthly leases (tacit renewal, deposit in months, triennial registration duties), so applying it to nightly stays would print terms that do not apply.

**How it is built:** `lib/rental-agreement-pdf/official-lease-fields.ts` maps the agreement to the template blanks (pure, tested by `official-lease-fields.test.mjs`); `official-lease.tsx` renders it; `daily-agreement.tsx` holds the former layout for daily stays. Nom and Prénom come from splitting `users.full_name` (built as « first last » from Clerk). Water and electricity are ticked OUI only when a listing amenity names them; otherwise both boxes stay empty (absence of an amenity does not prove NON).

**Signatures (2026-10-22, Salif):** each party may sign with a drawing made in the app. The PNG stays in a private bucket (`agreement-signatures`, service role only) and is drawn into the PDF under « Lu et approuvé. Signé électroniquement sur Roogo Burkina le JJ/MM/AAAA. ». Signing without a drawing stays accepted so older app versions keep working; their PDF shows the mention only.

**Ruled out:** Several fields sharing one line as in the paper form (Salif asked for atomic fields). Adding structured fields (ID number, issue date, issue place, profession, BP, lot, parcelle, section, secteur, title deed number and date) in the same change: proposed as a follow-up migration instead. Ticking NON when an amenity is missing. Translating the template for daily stays.

**Status:** Template layout merged in PR #86 on 2026-10-22. Drawn signatures on branch `feat/signature-contrat-bail`, not merged, migration 103 run by Salif on 2026-10-22. Not a legal review: wording is Salif's template, typos aside.

### Reply to every comment and message within 24 business hours — 2026-10-21

**Decision:** Salif (2026-10-21): the team answers ALL comments and direct messages within 24 business hours. The clock runs all 24 hours of Monday to Friday, Ouagadougou time (UTC, no daylight saving), and pauses on Saturday and Sunday. The start is the comment time, or the person's last message in a conversation. Received Tuesday 10:00 -> due Wednesday 10:00; Friday 18:00 -> Monday 18:00; Saturday 15:00 -> Tuesday 00:00. Studio > Réseaux shows the deadline on every card, the late items first, red badges with « dont N en retard », and for the Directeur and the Fondateur this week's response times.

**Why:** A buyer or an owner who writes on Facebook or Instagram and waits days is lost; a clear, visible deadline makes the inbox a daily duty rather than a when-we-can. Business hours keep the rule fair for a Monday-to-Friday team while still counting the whole working day (messages arrive in the evening).

**How it is built:** Working days are one constant (`BUSINESS_DAYS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` in `lib/social/sla.ts`), so Saturday can be added in one line. The late amount is counted in business time too (a reply due Friday 20:00 is « En retard de 4 h » all weekend). The team deadline is kept separate from Meta's messaging window, which decides only whether the Page may still send. Response times use the columns of migration 101 (no schema change): one reply per item (the last), « Marquer comme répondu » counts at the time it is pressed, and replies made directly in the Meta apps are listed apart because Meta gives neither the time nor the person.

**Ruled out:** A new migration to log every round of a conversation (not needed to start; possible later if per-round times matter). Counting the weekend in the late amount (would show « En retard de 2 j » on Monday morning for a Friday-evening miss). Working hours such as 08:00 to 18:00 (Salif chose the full 24 hours of working days).

**Status:** Branch `feat/studio-reseaux`, PR #82, not merged.

### End-of-day report and absences in the app — 2026-10-19

**Decision:** Every staff member sends a short end-of-day report from Mon espace (from 15:00 Ouagadougou, highlighted from 17:30): what they did, 1 to 5 actions for tomorrow that become their own tasks, what did not work today, and how we could do better. Absences are declared in the same form, or by the Directeur or the Fondateur on someone’s behalf, with one of four categories and an optional private note. Design from the council recommendation, approved by Salif on 2026-10-19; the four parts were set by Salif the same day.

**Why:** On 2026-10-19 Moubarak was absent for a family emergency and the only trace was Ablassé’s phone call to Salif. Logging days and absences gives data to learn from and plan around, and the two reflection questions turn the report into a daily improvement loop rather than a check-in.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** WhatsApp or SMS reminders (in-app highlight only). Asking for medical details (the category is enough; the form says not to write any). A free-text « Demain » (actions become real tasks instead, so the next day starts from them). Altering `staff_tasks` to link back to the report (the task ids are stored in the new table). Counting Saturday in the weekly x/5 (Monday to Friday only; Saturday reports are kept).

**Status:** Branch `feat/compte-rendu-fin-de-journee`, not merged. Migration `099_staff_day_reports.sql` not run; the app shows « migration 099 à lancer » until then.

### One staff bar on every page, five entries with « Plus » — 2026-10-20

**Decision:** A signed-in staff member or founder sees the same bar on public pages (`/`, `/proprietes`…) and in the back office: the public Navbar renders `AdminNavbar` for them, fed by the one list in `lib/navigation/adminNav.ts` and filtered by the level's capabilities. The bar is « Accueil » (count badge), « Annonces », « Messages » (Ventes, Support), « Studio » (approvals badge), « Plus ». « Plus » holds, under small headings: Opérations (Visites, Appels à biens, Candidatures, Modifications, Identités, Documents propriété, RCCM hôtels, Événements hôtels), Pilotage (Analyses, Accès, Finances, Paramètres), Développement (Talent, Parrainage). Empty groups disappear (a Stagiaire has no Messages). Labels show from 1024 px; below that, the phone menu. Guests, renters, owners, agents and hotels keep the public list. Supersedes the six-entry bar of 2026-10-18.

**Why:** Salif (2026-10-20, production screenshots): staff saw a different bar on the home page (no Accueil, no badge, smaller labels without icons) that "expanded" on the way into the back office, and the six entries were still too many. Accueil, Annonces and Messages are daily; Opérations pages are a few times a week and Finances and Paramètres are founder-only and rare, so they move one click away.

**Ruled out:** Keeping a staff variant inside the public Navbar (two lists drift, which is how this happened); icons-only top entries (labels fit from 1024 px once there are five).

**Open:** On public pages there is no server answer for the level, so the bar uses the Clerk metadata with the levels rollout switch off (`useStaffAccess`). While `STAFF_LEVELS_ENFORCED` is off this is identical; once it is on, a staff member without a level would see the legacy items on public pages and the advisor items in the back office. API routes enforce the real level either way.

### Admin navbar: Accueil, five entries, avatar only — 2026-10-18

**Decision:** The first admin item is « Accueil » (was « Mon espace »). Talent and Parrainage move from « Développement » into « Pilotage » under a « Développement » heading, so the bar has Accueil, Annonces, Studio, Messages, Opérations, Pilotage. The name and email leave the bar: the avatar opens Clerk's menu, which shows both. From 1024 to 1279 px the bar shows icons with tooltips and screen-reader labels; labels appear from 1280 px.

**Why:** Salif (2026-10-18): the bar was too big, « Mon espace » wrapped and the name and email were truncated. « Accueil » is the shortest label every French speaker reads as "the home of this space", and it covers tasks, goals and demandes; « Aujourd’hui » was rejected because the page is more than today. Développement and Pilotage are the least used groups.

**Ruled out:** « Bureau » (clear but less familiar as a menu word), « Tableau de bord » (too long), « Briefing » (anglicism); a « Plus » menu (hides where things are without saving more width than the merge).

### Users goal counts Clerk accounts, Supabase rows are the comparison — 2026-10-18

**Decision:** The « utilisateurs » goal counts Clerk accounts minus staff, founder, admin (`publicMetadata.userType`) and test addresses (`+clerk_test`, `@example.com/.org`). Creation times are cached 10 minutes in Upstash Redis (per-instance memory without Redis). Supabase `users` rows stay as the « Fiches Roogo » line next to « Comptes Clerk » and as the fallback when Clerk does not answer.

**Why:** Salif (2026-10-18): the number did not match reality. A `users` row is created only when a Clerk user first reaches the API (`lib/user-sync.ts`), so accounts that signed up and never came back were missing. Clerk is where accounts live.

**Ruled out:** running a backfill silently (a script is provided, dry run by default, for Salif to run against production); counting Supabase rows and Clerk accounts together.

### TikTok followers come from TikTok's official API after one founder authorization — 2026-10-18

**Decision:** The founder connects @roogo.226 once with TikTok Login Kit (scope `user.info.stats`). Access (24 hours) and refresh (365 days) tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM (`SOCIAL_TOKENS_KEY`) in `social_tokens`, readable by the service role only. The nightly cron refreshes the access token when it has less than 10 minutes left, keeps TikTok's new refresh token, reads `follower_count` from `/v2/user/info/` and writes a reading with source « automatique ». Without a connection the cron answers `tiktok: "not connected"` and readings stay manual.

**Why:** Salif asked for TikTok to be read like Facebook and Instagram. TikTok's Display API is the only legitimate source; scraping the website is ruled out. Without the encryption key nothing is stored, so tokens never sit in clear in the database.

### Every live listing meets a quality minimum and is checked on Google daily — 2026-10-18

**Decision:** A listing goes live (`en_ligne`) only with a description of at least 60 words and at least 5 photos (`lib/listing-quality.ts`, enforced by `PATCH /api/properties/[id]/status`, code `listing_quality_minimum`; test listings exempt). A daily cron asks the Search Console URL Inspection API whether each live listing is indexed; `/admin/annonces/google` lists every live listing with its quality checklist and Google status, and flags a listing not on Google 7 days after the check first saw it live. Listing pages lead with what people search: title "Terrain à vendre à Roumtinga, Ouagadougou : 8 500 000 FCFA", the same headline as H1, and an « En résumé » paragraph built only from the listing's fields. Approved by Salif on 2026-10-18.

**Why:** On 2026-10-18 Search Console showed 12 listing and owner pages "Discovered - currently not indexed", found by chance. The discovery cause (sale listings not linked anywhere) was fixed in PR #75. The audit then showed 27 of 36 live listings under the new minimum, many with one-line descriptions ("Très belle opportunité de ça immobilier"), which Google often declines to index. Listings are the business; indexing cannot be left to chance or to someone opening Search Console.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** Blocking owners at submission (older mobile builds validate 10 characters and 3 photos, and owner acquisition is the main constraint; staff complete a listing before publishing instead). The Google Indexing API (officially for job postings and livestreams only). Manual "Request indexing" as the process (about 10 per day). Unpublishing the 27 incomplete live listings (they stay live; the staff page lists them to complete).

**Status:** Branch `feat/listing-quality-indexing`, not merged. Migration 098 not run. The cron needs `GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` (a service account added as a user on the `sc-domain:roogobf.com` property); until then it returns `skipped`.

### The access page is /admin/acces — 2026-10-17

**Decision:** The staff levels page (invitations, access journal, setting levels) lives at `/admin/acces`, named « Accès » in the navigation. Salif chose the French word for access over `/admin/equipe/niveaux`.

**Why:** `/admin/equipe` became the L'équipe board, and a page under it would read as a part of the board rather than the place where access is given.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** `/admin/equipe/niveaux` with « Niveaux d’accès » (rejected by Salif on 2026-10-17).

**Status:** Branch `feat/team-dashboard`, not merged. The page keeps the `team.manage` guard; the API routes enforce the same rule. On `feat/fiche-visite` the page becomes one page « Accès » with two tabs: « Qui peut faire quoi » (`/admin/acces`, every staff member, default) and « Niveaux et invitations » (`/admin/acces/niveaux`, `team.manage` only, guarded on the server as before). Sub-routes rather than `?vue=` so the existing route guard protects the levels tab unchanged.

### The users table is private; public owner fields come only from the listing view (security) — 2026-10-17

**Decision:** No client role (anon key, Clerk-authenticated) writes `users`. Signed-in users read only their own row (`clerk_id = auth.jwt() ->> 'sub'`); the anon key reads no row. What a listing card shows about its owner (name, avatar, phone, badges) is decided by `public_property_details` alone, which now runs with its owner's rights and never returns a renter. The change ships in two migrations: 094 (writes, `staff_users`, renter fields) is safe for every app in the field; 095 (read lock) runs only after the mobile update that reads the own row with the Clerk token.

**Why:** On 2026-10-16 the public anon key, shipped in the website bundle and the app, could read all 695 users rows (695 emails, 570 phones, 116 WhatsApp numbers, 691 signup IPs, budgets, staff levels) and the staff list, and held the UPDATE privilege on `users`, so a client could likely rewrite `user_type` and pass every policy that trusts it.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** Column revokes alone (old apps `select *` on `users` and would break the same way, while every row stayed listable). A policy that shows only owners of live listings (still exposes those rows' WhatsApp, IP and preferences to anyone). A single migration (it would cut old apps off profile, favourites and "Mes propriétés" the day it runs). Moving the reads to new API routes (the authenticated Supabase client already exists and support chat already relies on it).

**Status:** Branch `fix/users-table-exposure` (web and mobile), not merged, not run. Open: the anon key can still read every `properties` column, including `seller_asking_price` of sale listings, and agent contacts of non-live listings through the view; listed as follow-ups in the PR.

### Sales come from a « Vendu » listing status; follower counts are read from Meta every night — 2026-10-16

**Decision:** A sale listing is marked « Vendu » (`properties.status = 'vendu'`, migration 093) with the notary signing date (`sold_at`), the sale price (`sold_price`) and who marked it (`sold_by`). Only the Directeur or the Fondateur can set or undo it, only on a non-test sale listing, and the date cannot be in the future (`lib/property-status.ts`, enforced in `PATCH /api/properties/[id]/status`). The sales goal counts `vendu` listings whose `sold_at` falls in the goal window, any property type including land. The founder-confirmed `team_goal_sales` table and its route are removed. « Expirée » no longer means "rented or sold". Facebook and Instagram followers are read every night at 02:00 UTC from the Meta Graph API (`/api/cron/social-followers`, readings with `source = 'automatique'`); typing a reading by hand stays as the fallback and remains the only way for TikTok. The goal « 500 abonnés Instagram » for 2026 is seeded in 093 (1 follower on 2026-10-16).

**Why:** Salif (2026-10-16): "add a sold state in db so we can know for certain without manual checks", and follower goals should update without anyone typing numbers. A status on the listing is where staff already work, and it also takes a sold property off the market.

**Ruled out:** keeping founder-confirmed sales next to the status (two sources of truth that can disagree); inferring a sale from a completed notary meeting (nothing in the app marks a meeting completed today); reading followers on every page view (Meta rate limits and a slow page).

### Team goals: every number from a record, founder-only changes, sales confirmed by hand — 2026-10-16

**Decision:** « Nos objectifs » (Mon espace, now Accueil, and `/admin/objectifs`) shows goals the founder sets, each with a metric, a target and a period (`month`, `recurring_month`, `quarter`, `year`). Numbers are computed at read time from their own records: users (users rows minus staff, founder and test accounts), properties under an active rental agreement, properties put online in the period, and sales. Roogo has no "sold" status, so a sale counts only once the founder confirms it in `team_goal_sales` (property and notary signature date). Follower counts (TikTok, Facebook, Instagram) are manual readings with an optional screenshot in a private bucket, keyed by metric (the count belongs to the account, not to a goal); no server-side Meta Graph token exists, so Facebook is manual too. Status words come from the real pace against the required pace (En bonne voie at 100% or more, À suivre from 60%, Il faut agir below, Atteint, Pas atteint once the period is over); a pace is judged only after a week of measurement. Only the founder creates, archives, retargets goals, edits levers and confirms sales; founder and Directeur enter readings; a lever is ticked by its owner, the Directeur or the founder. All of it is enforced in `lib/team-goals/server.ts`.

**Why:** Approved on the design canvas with Salif (2026-10-16): "nothing on this dash is static; every number has its proof". The evidence drawer shows that proof, with counts only for users (no names, emails or phones).

**Ruled out:** a nightly counter table (the numbers are cheap to compute live and cannot drift); inferring a sale from a notary meeting or a locked listing (neither proves a signed deed).

### Call tasks need a result before they are done; demandes get three answers — 2026-10-16

**Decision:** A task can be a call (`is_call`). « Appeler et noter » records the result, notes and the next step in `staff_call_notes`; saving creates the next task (rappel, visite à confirmer, a task for the Directeur, or a demande to the founder when the Directeur is the caller) and closes the call task. The server refuses to tick a call task without a note (rule approved by Salif). Notes are visible to their author, the Directeur and the founder only. « Répondre » on a demande is replaced by « Oui, vas-y » (closed as approved), « Pas maintenant » (hidden until a date, then pending again) and « Écrire une réponse » (a thread in `staff_task_messages` that either side closes with « Réglé »); « Je m’en occupe » is unchanged. The sender sees new answers in Mon espace (« Réponse de Salif » card, count on the navbar item) until opened; no push or email.

**Why:** Designed with Salif on 2026-10-16: calls were ticked without a trace, and a single text answer could not say "go ahead" or "later".

**Ruled out:** auto-flagging automatic briefing items as calls; none of today's sources says a callback is due.

### The access page is generated from one matrix file — 2026-10-16

**Decision:** "Qui peut faire quoi" (`/admin/acces`) describes the access levels exactly as the code enforces them on this branch, from a single typed file, `lib/access/matrix.ts`. A test (`lib/access/matrix.test.mjs`) ties the file to the real helpers and fails when a staff API route is added without being described. What the vault proposal of 2026-10-11 approves but the code does not enforce is listed separately as "Prévu mais pas encore appliqué", never as current behaviour. The page is linked from the Pilotage menu (every staff member) and from L'équipe, not from a new top-level navbar item. Since 2026-10-17 it is the default tab of « Accès », next to « Niveaux et invitations » ([decision](#the-access-page-is-adminacces--2026-10-17)).

**Why:** The team needs one place to know what each title can do, and the founder needs to see where the app still allows more than the approved matrix. A hand-written page would drift from the code; a matrix checked by a test cannot drift silently.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** Deriving the page automatically from the route files (checks are written in too many styles to parse reliably). Showing the vault matrix as if it were live. A new top-level navbar item (too noisy for a reference page).

**Status:** Built on branch `feat/fiche-visite`, not deployed. Rewritten on 2026-10-17 when main brought the staff levels (PR 67): the rules now follow `STAFF_CAPABILITY_MATRIX` and the test checks them against it. See [how it works](./SYSTEM.md#how-does-staff-access-work-and-where-is-it-written-down).

### The field visit sheet moves into the app — 2026-10-15

**Decision:** The "Fiche de visite de bien" (paper sheet of 2 October 2026) is filled in Roogo, from the listing page or the briefing, following the approved canvas (phone and computer). Tick times are the device's own clock; the four time buttons notify the team inside Roogo (briefing "Sur le terrain aujourd’hui"), WhatsApp is optional. Files are uploaded only at "Retour au bureau", one button per deliverable, into `Biens / Vente|Location / <CODE> <titre> / <type>` in the shared Drive. "Photos et vidéos supprimées des appareils" can be ticked only once every deliverable has a file confirmed by Drive. Sending the sheet creates six manual tasks (source key `field-visit:<id>:<task>`, so finishing twice creates nothing new) due on business days (Monday to Friday), and stores the planned publication dates (J+1, J+2, J+4, J+5).

**Why:** The paper sheet relied on memory and WhatsApp; the tick times show the Directeur and the founder when each thing was really done, and nothing is lost when the phone has no network (autosave on the phone and on the server).

**Ruled out / alternatives:** A "Règles de publication" screen in the flow (rejected by Salif). Uploads on site at step 3 (step 3 stays a checklist; files go up on the office Wi-Fi). Sending WhatsApp messages through an API (only a share link). Creating publications in the Studio calendar now (that branch is not merged; `lib/field-visits/publications.ts` is the hook).

**Status:** Built on branch `feat/fiche-visite`, not deployed. Open points: Burkina public holidays are not skipped yet; the Drive folder name follows the canvas (`<CODE> <titre>`) while the paper sheet and the Studio's Médias du terrain panel use `Quartier - Nom du propriétaire`, so the same property can get two folders until one rule is chosen. Migrations 086 and 090 have run on Roogo (recorded 2026-10-17); needs the Google service account env vars. See [how it works](./SYSTEM.md#how-does-the-field-visit-sheet-fiche-de-visite-work).

### Staff access by job title, with invitations instead of a shared code — 2026-10-11

**Decision:** Staff access follows the job title (founder, director, assistant, advisor, intern), not individual tool permissions. Only the founder and directors give access; a director cannot name another director; nobody changes their own level. The shared `STAFF_REGISTRATION_SECRET` is replaced by invitation links, and every grant is journaled for the founder. Salif approved the matrix on 2026-10-11, with the director allowed to see the users list, validate and pay referral commissions, and read finances (read only).

**Why:** Ablassé raised the risk that someone with full access can copy the system or leave with the data. The old model gave every staff member the same rights, including deleting listings and reading identity papers, and anyone who knew the shared code could make themselves staff.

**Ruled out / alternatives:** Per-task permissions (too many settings for a team of four; the title stays the key and its tasks justify the access). A matrix with an approval for every action (it would stall a team whose founder is often asleep in another time zone). Enforcing levels on day one: unleveled staff would lose access at deploy, so `STAFF_LEVELS_ENFORCED` stays off until levels are assigned.
